The generated predictor imports the updated model class; checkpoint parameter shapes remain unchanged.","edits":[{"find":"class BERT4RecModel(nn.Module):","replace":"class ScaledFFNEncoderLayer(nn.TransformerEncoderLayer):
    def forward(self, src: torch.Tensor, src_mask=None,
                src_key_padding_mask=None, is_causal: bool = False) -> torch.Tensor:
        x = src
        x = x + self._sa_block(
            self.norm1(x), src_mask, src_key_padding_mask,
            is_causal=is_causal,
        )
        x = x + 0.5 * self._ff_block(self.norm2(x))
        return x
